reviews.title: GREAT REFURBISHED 3080ti FE!! Raw Rasterizing HP! bandwidth! 5/5 star!
reviews.comment: Fantastic price on a fantastic card that is in my opinion the best card available VR and modern gaming safe for its high power consumption! This thing has the bandwidth which the newer cards lack and it’s Bill qualities as of course outstanding since it is an actual Nvidia founders edition card! With mine, it runs fairly quietly and even running a half-life Alex on my quest, three wirelessly with the stand alone Pupis S-1 WiFi 6 5g wireless connection for my Meta Quest 3 headset with HL Alex set to mid-high to high graphical quality, it didn’t even blink an eye paired with a Intel 12700kn CPU, 32 gigs of cl6000 ddr5 ram Ina Asus z970 DDr5 WiFi capable MB… great refurbish job and it comes with all needed accessories!!( make sure you use the included power cable! It fits flawlessly and functions great!! Very pleased with my purchase for my 2nd ever gaming PC build. The installation was as simple as ever , make sure your case fits the size of the card though!  And the durability so far after 3 months has been fantastic… can’t go wrong with this card for the money since even now in early 2026 a brand new founders edition rtx3080Ti runs close to $1600 !! I got the highest level of refurbished condition and it arrived very quickly and has served me very well thus far! I went ahead and got the monthly insurance for this item and my other electronics and so far it’s been worth the $16 a month! Great card and professionally refurbished! Packaged and performs excellently! The sheer HP this 3080ti packs ain’t no joke! HL Alex on high settings on both the stereoscopic headset which = 2x 4k small screens running smoothly, AND my 50” 4k tv used as a monitor ALSO Displaying THE game and it runs flawlessly!! Well done Amazon and Nvidia!

reviews.title: refurbished GPU at a good price.
reviews.comment: Great GPU card. Runs everything smoothly. can set most of my games at max setting. bought the card a year ago  refurbished for $699.00. upgraded from rtx2080ti. glad I did. The current market for current GPU cards is crazy expensive. And there are soooo many to chose from. It seems i will wait a year to buy a newer model when things hopefully will clam down.
reviews.author: henricus

reviews.title: Skeptical at first but she works
reviews.comment: Bought mine in September and its still running smooth. Bought for BorderLands 4 and it ran the game very well. Runs BF6, Arc and whatever other game I play smoothly with graphic settings on high or ultra. No complaints
